extensions.status: Approved hybrid performance console; fresh finish review returned ship with no material interface defect. No commit, push or deployment is claimed.

instrument.purpose: Locally hosted Barlow 700; instrument headings 23px/1.05 desktop and phone; wordmark 25px desktop and 19px phone.

panel-label.purpose: Segoe UI utility text; IBM Plex Mono reserved for musical and inset transport/register displays at 11, 19, 23 and 25px. Legacy bundled Silkscreen, Departure Mono, VT323 and Press Start 2P base roles remain documented in DESIGN.md.

shadows.purpose: Crisp transport/status displays with 4px radii; panels and utility controls use the 3px theme radius.
shadows.name: display-inset

motion.name: press-travel
motion.purpose: State uses fill and borders without simulated key travel.

motion.name: playback
motion.purpose: Retain existing musical feedback, avoid per-frame DOM writes, and honor reduced motion in CSS and JavaScript.
One 3px top-edge LaneMeter line per lane with horizontal fill; no redundant decorative header animation.
motion.name: lane-signal

theme.scope: Device preference outside project data, undo and exports. Storage failures retain current-session switching.

pitchWindow.domain: Scale-only MIDI 0 through 127, derived independently of saved row lists
pitchWindow.orientation: Descending MIDI: highest pitch at top, lower pitches beneath
pitchWindow.viewSteps: One semitone or twelve semitones, bounded by physical MIDI range
pitchWindow.degreeEnvelope: -128 through 128; addNote also checks resolved MIDI bounds
pitchWindow.identity: Stored degree is stable during view changes; browsing, scrolling and zoom never transpose or write musical data
pitchWindow.phoneFit: Viewport-bounded available space minus panel padding, border and all following siblings; 44px base row floor, 64px fill ceiling, 1 to 2 geometry zoom
pitchWindow.virtualization: Full semantic pitch range retained; only the seated octave materialized. Phone scrollbars hidden without disabling touch panning, preserving seven complete heptatonic rows and footer.

visualizer.controls: 24 effects per lane, Flowing trails and Orbit, 35 to 130 percent scale, 0 to 100 percent orbit strength; four tabs and one inspector
visualizer.signal: Actual audible MIDI hold/release, up to 16 overlapping notes per lane; silence and effective mute draw nothing, stop clears, reduced motion uses bounded text
visualizer.limitation: Closed by passing VZ-TH-4 dense frame-budget gate; DPR cap is 0.75. Historical measurements remain in docs/dev/perf-budget.md.

extensions.verification: Parent task reports typecheck, lint, 89 unit files / 1772 tests, 21 fuzz tests, production build, pitch-direction, target-size isolated, focused accessibility/VIZ/happy-path pack, LP1 5/5, frame-budget 12/12 in 178.49 seconds. Documentation pass validates records, not a rerun.
extensions.branding: Supplied Bitbounce logo, Barlow wordmark and local SVG favicon in src/assets/branding; dark Vector luminous, light Alloy polished silver.

components.name: Instrument panel
components.description: Hybrid instrument panel with Barlow 23px heading and a single audible top-edge LaneMeter signal.

narrative.northStar: Hybrid performance console: Vector dark and Alloy light
narrative.overview: Approved hybrid console with supplied Bitbounce logo and wordmark, crisp inset musical displays and one audible signal line per instrument. Dark Vector is luminous; light Alloy polished silver. Four-panel desktop and single-lane phone workflows remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: Locally hosted Barlow Bold instrument names and Segoe UI utility text
Thin-bordered panels, crisp inset Plex displays and one top-edge audible LaneMeter signal per lane
Scale-only rows in descending pitch order with view-only register navigation
Theme preference remains outside musical documents

rules.name: Theme roles
rules.body: Use active semantic CSS variables. Filled notes use ink-on-fill; selected transport and mix controls use ink with ground text. State retains labels and ARIA equivalents.

rules.name: View identity
rules.body: Higher pitches appear above lower pitches. View navigation changes the visible register without changing stored degrees, sound or undo.

rules.name: Functional depth
rules.body: Inset musical displays use 4px radii; panels and controls use 3px. Audible light carries activity without redundant decorative animation.

rules.name: VIZ signal
rules.body: Artwork follows real audible MIDI. Silent and effectively muted lanes draw nothing; reduced motion uses bounded textual summaries.

dos: Do preserve four-panel desktop and single-lane phone interaction.
Do reserve footer space when fitting phone rows and retain the 44px base floor.
Do preserve chain-slot identity and audible-time playback follow.
Do preserve keyboard editing, focus, ARIA and reduced motion.
donts: Don't restore superseded Machined Console visual prescriptions.
Don't transpose music while browsing the pitch window.
Don't add expensive decoration inside virtualized cells or per-frame playback DOM writes.
Don't claim verification, release or performance improvements from this documentation.
